ai.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with a ‘significant leap’ in cybersecurity
ai.brief: Gemini 4 Carbon is outperforming the top models from OpenAI and Anthropic on some benchmarks. Gemini 4 Carbon is outperforming the top models from OpenAI and Anthropic on some benchmarks. Google has released its latest frontier model, Gemini 4 Carbon, offering “significant gains” in coding, agentic tasks, and cybersecurity. 5 and GPT-6 Astra trailing behind. The new Gemini 4 Carbon model offers improvements over Argon, which Google released earlier this month. It’s currently only available to a select group of cybersecurity defense companies, but it will eventually expand to other partners in its Fairwind Program . The company says Carbon reflects the “pace at which we’re pushing the frontier forward,” coming with a “significant leap” in cyberdefense that makes it better at finding vulnerabilities and generating secure code.
